design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Low Impact Development Runoff Capture Volume (ROCV): Impervious Surface Area (sq ft) × 1 inch = ROCV. ROCV requirement may be met by (1) retaining the minimum ROCV for ≥24 hours, (2) treating the discharge from the 2-year storm, or (3) a combination. Detailed LID design per City of Flagstaff LID Guidance Manual.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Rational Method / hydrograph methods per Ch.4 Hydrology
On-site detention for developments >1/4 acre (policies in §5.3.8)
2-year detention waived if site fully captures ROCV
